notes: Passes to motive E and virtual components h_!^i(E) with virtual Betti numbers beta_i(E); explicitly invokes Weil conjectures in decomposition/determinant computation.
Claims i beta_i/2 always integral and discriminant sign epsilon_i=+1 in odd weight; the need for a motivic alternating pairing is central to later research, not derivable from absolute values alone.
Formula delta(E)=epsilon(E)p^(1/2 sum(-1)^i i beta_i(E)) defines determinant exponent in terms of virtual weight-graded numbers; compare with ordinary cohomological Betti numbers in earlier pages.
Terminology signe de discriminant virtuel merits context search and comparison to determinant signs, without conflating square-class discriminant and real sign.
